subject: Connecting HCM patient communities
body:
Dear Cardiomyopathy Patient Council,

My name is Maria, and I lead a patient group for HCM (MYH7). I am reaching out because our communities share a focus on the same condition.

A paper reports that the Cardiomyopathy Patient Council "was formed in November 2021 and brings together patient organisations across the world to increase awareness and understanding of cardiomyopathy" [E5a3bbe2]. Given this shared focus on cardiomyopathy, I believe there may be valuable opportunities for our groups to learn from one another and support our respective communities.

Would you be open to a short introductory call in the coming weeks to explore whether there are natural areas of collaboration, such as sharing awareness resources or coordinating on patient education efforts? I would be glad to work around your schedule.

Thank you for the important work your council does, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Maria
Patient Group Leader, HCM (MYH7) Patient Group

Sources:
[E5a3bbe2] https://globalhearthub.org/patient-councils/cardiomyopathy-patient-council/
